CENSUS RESULT — no consumer anywhere in this repo reads a buyer-side agent/office NAME, and the local store physically cannot hold one.

(1) CLOSED COMP → BUYER AGENT/OFFICE: NO consumer attempts it. `lib/comps/fetch-comps.ts` requests `CARD_SELECT_FIELDS` (`lib/idx/card-fields.ts`), whose entire Agent/Office section is two names — `ListAgentFullName`, `ListOfficeName` (card-fields.ts:44-45); zero `Buyer*`/`CoBuyer*` names are in the $select, so a Closed comp row cannot even carry them. `mapToCompListing` (fetch-comps.ts:65-90) emits `listing_agent`/`listing_office` from the LIST side only, and no UI reads those two keys (grep for `listing_agent|listing_office` across `public/` and `app/` returns only `lib/comps/*`). `lib/cma/engine.ts` selects no agent/office column at all. `lib/market-report/generator.ts` selects `ListOfficeName` only and filters `StandardStatus eq 'Active'` (line 155-157), so it never sees a Closed row. The ONE place a Closed row's brokerage is rendered is the LIST office: `app/agents/[name]/page.tsx:225` (`listingCourtesy: l.listOfficeName`) → `PastDealsSection.tsx:112` ("Listing Courtesy of …") — and that line fires even on rows the agent reached as the BUYER-side agent, so a buyer-side deal is labelled with the other brokerage's list office. That is correct-by-construction, not a buyer-side read.

(2) AGENT-LISTINGS BUYER-SIDE HISTORY: MlsId match ONLY — the name is never needed or read. `lib/idx/fetch.ts:533` builds `(ListAgentMlsId eq '<id>' or BuyerAgentMlsId eq '<id>')`; `syncAgentHistory` (`lib/idx/sync.ts:2346`, write at 2415-2490) stamps the LOCAL `agent_id = options.agentDbId` and derives only the 8 LIST-side typed columns (`typedAgentColumnsFromJson`, sync.ts:2484). The route then re-reads rows purely by `agent_id: agentId` (`app/api/agents/[slug]/listings/route.ts:212`) plus `AGENT_TYPED_SELECT` (list-side only, `lib/listings/agent-info-resolver.ts:75-84`). Nuance worth flagging: the route's OWN Trestle branch matches `ListAgentMlsId` only (route.ts:151-154) — buyer-side rows reach the page exclusively through the DB branch, i.e. only if `syncAgentHistory` ran. Feed-wise this is the one buyer-side path that WORKS, because `BuyerAgentMlsId` is one of the two buyer scalars that survives suppression (100,112 rows).

(3) VIEWER BINDINGS: the two census viewers bind ZERO suppressed buyer fields. Enumerating every `data-rls-field="…"` value in `SALE-FORM-WITH-TOOLS.html` (157 bindings) and `RENTAL-FORM-WITH-TOOLS.html` (227 bindings) yields no name containing `Agent` or `Office`. Their buyer/tenant-agent blocks are deliberately inert: every input carries `data-rls-ignore="true"` (SALE:1497-1508, 3603; RENTAL:1480, 3061) and the RLS-participant checkbox carries `data-removed-field="BuyerAgentRLSParticipantYN"` (RENTAL:1494). The sale viewer's buyer block has no JS at all — `initSearchableDropdown({listId:'buyerCompanyList'})` exists only in the out-of-census `SALE-FORM-REDESIGN.html:6178`. The rental viewer's tenant block IS wired (6495-6510) but against a hardcoded local stub `var rebnyAgents = { 'mallan': [] }` (6306) with no loader — never a provider read. The out-of-census sibling `SALE-FORM-REDESIGN.html` is the only file that binds six suppressed buyer scalars (`BuyerAgentFullName/DirectPhone/Email/StateLicense`, `BuyerOfficeName/Phone`, lines 710-715, 9225-9230) — as `src: 'raw'` form inputs, so they hold agent-typed values, never feed values.

STORAGE FLOOR (why none of this could work even if attempted): `lib/idx/trestle-mapper.ts:460-465` strips `BuyerAgentMlsId/Email/DirectPhone` and the CoBuyer trio from `raw_data`; `slimRawData` (mapper:1240) then keeps only `RAW_DATA_KEEP_FIELDS`, whose Agent/Office section (`lib/compliance/raw-data-keep-fields.ts:169-181`) contains ZERO `Buyer*` names. `agent_info` JSON was removed from the model entirely (`prisma/schema.prisma:480`), leaving eight LIST-side typed columns (schema:516-523) and no buyer-side column anywhere. `listings_archive` likewise stores `list_agent_full_name`/`list_office_name` only (schema:725-726, written at `lib/retention/archive-terminals.ts:160-161`). `PublicListingDTO` exposes exactly one attribution field, `listOfficeName` (`lib/idx/public-dto.ts:182-183`). The CRM compliance gates actively classify `BuyerAgentMlsId` as a LEAK field (`public/crm/js/compliance/compliance-gates-and-output.js:1547`).

RESIDUAL DEAD CODE (no user-visible defect, worth knowing): the viewers' `(apiData.agent_info || {}).ListAgentFullName` fallbacks (SALE:4956-4957, 4991-4992; RENTAL:4368-4369, 4402-4403) and `data-loader.js:255-256`'s `agent.ListOfficeName` branch reference a column dropped from the Prisma model, so they are permanently unreachable. `viewerSetVal('saleListAgentMlsId', d.listAgentMlsId)` (SALE:5157) has no producer for `d.listAgentMlsId` in that file. Public read-side census of every agent/office value, traced storage → output. THE FEED SIDE ACTUALLY PUBLISHED IS LIST-SIDE ONLY. Public attribution is office-name-only by design (lib/idx/public-dto.ts:182); ListAgentFullName is fetched (lib/idx/card-fields.ts:47) but no public card renders it. Storage is typed columns list_agent_full_name / list_office_name / list_agent_email / list_agent_direct_phone (+4 MLS-id columns) via resolveListingAgentInfo, with the now-dropped agent_info JSON as fallback. ListOfficeName is populated on 591,607 rows, so every neutral 'REBNY RLS' fallback is latent rather than live.

BUYER-SIDE — NO surface renders a buyer or co-buyer agent name or office. BuyerAgentFullName / BuyerOfficeName / CoBuyer* are picked into the in-memory agent_info (lib/idx/trestle-mapper.ts:1133-1138) but are dropped by BOTH persistence seams: typedAgentColumnsFromJson extracts only the 8 list-side keys, PRIVATE_FIELDS strips the buyer PII, and RAW_DATA_KEEP_FIELDS keeps no Buyer* key. No BuyerAgent→Member / BuyerOffice→Office expand is ever requested (only Media and CustomProperty expands exist, lib/idx/fetch.ts:131-140). Closed-row attribution on building history and agent Past Deals correctly uses ListOfficeName.

BUT BUYER-SIDE IDENTITY LEAKS INDIRECTLY, AND THIS IS THE TOP FINDING. lib/idx/db-to-public-dto.ts:294 classifies a row 'mallan-exclusive' when `agent_id != null`. syncAgentHistory (lib/idx/sync.ts:2455) stamps agent_id on THIRD-PARTY feed rows fetched by `ListAgentMlsId eq X or BuyerAgentMlsId eq X` (lib/idx/fetch.ts:533/559); BuyerAgentMlsId is populated on 100,112 rows. Five other files already carry the correction that agent_id is NOT ownership; classifyDbListing is the one reader that never got it. On such a row the public DTO emits `attributionText: 'Exclusive listing by Mallan Real Estate Inc.'` with `disclaimerRequired: false` (db-to-public-dto.ts:715-716) — a false claim of brokerage under 19 NYCRR 175.25 and UCBA Art. III §2(C) — plus `_assignedAgent` carrying the OTHER brokerage's agent name, email and direct phone (697-709). app/api/listings/route.ts selects agent_id (382) alongside list_agent_email/list_agent_direct_phone (374) and serializes the result through toPublicListingSummaries (629), which passes `_assignedAgent` through untouched; the detail page inherits it at page.tsx:639 and renders mailto:/tel: links at 2057-2075. lib/search/public-listing-db.ts:331 compounds it: `?sort=exclusives` is implemented as `where.agent_id = { not: null }`, the exact predicate its own comment at 214-222 forbids.

CO-LIST — the co-list agent is shown ZERO times, not once, so the "only the first of CoListAgent2/3" failure mode cannot arise: CoListAgentFullName/CoListOfficeName are retained in raw_data (raw-data-keep-fields.ts:180-181) with no reader anywhere; CoListAgent2FullName/CoListAgent3FullName (~51k/~8k rows) reach agent_info via B9 but are in neither the typed columns nor the keep-list; only co_list_agent_mls_id / co_list_office_mls_id persist, as syndication gates. `_coListedBrokerages` is NOT co-list data — it is a same-address collision heuristic over one response page (public-dto.ts:368-416) and is itself mis-triggered by the agent_id mislabel via isMallanRelevantListing.
